contract: Deduplicate transitions in first-occurrence order across the structural candidate paths.
Search enabled transitions breadth-first on copied markings and marking keys.
Each transition may fire at most once in a trial, and transitions already visited by the surrounding search are excluded.
Commit only a complete sequence that enables the selected transition; unsuccessful searches leave replay state unchanged.
Successful trial firings do not modify the surrounding visited set.
reproduction: Decompress each reference gzip to JSON.
Run scripts/check-token-replay-native.py against the replay reference and scripts/check-petri-element-usage-native.py against the usage reference, supplying --reference, --native, and --output.
The model reference retains input nets, ordered candidate paths, initial visited names, and exact public helper activation sequences.
limits: Finite observations do not establish full parity.
The native exhaustive trial search explicitly reports its 4096-state and 64 MiB retained-node payload resource bounds; temporary firing scratch is outside that accounting.
Variable reference choices among alternative structural paths remain outside this deterministic checkpoint.
